NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of the immovableproperty, shown in the following schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, for theconstruction of the Yanthampalawa Waste Water Pump House under the Grater Kurunegala Water Supply and SanitationProject.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning and
Water Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,22nd June, 2016.5/2/1/1223

An allotment of land called Kumbalkotuwe Watta, situated at the village of Wilgoda, in the Grama NiladhariDivision of No. 832 Kurunegala Town - Gangoda Wasama in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kurunegala and inKurunengala District and in extent of about 14 perches from the total land bounded as follows :—

North by:Road from Puwakgas Handiya (Junction) to Yantampalawa (Road Development Authority)and part of Lot No. 6B of the Authorized Survey Plan No. 543 ;East by:Part of the Lot No. 6B of the Authorized Survey Plan No. 543 ;South by:Remaining part of this land and the land owned by Mr. Leel Raveendra Munasinghe ;West by:Road from Puwakgas Handiya to Yanthampalawa (Road Develoment Authority) andremaining part of this land.
Name and address of the claimant :Sunri Advertising Services (Pvt.) Ltd.No. 301, Puttalam Road,Kurunegala.
